content.short: MANSA provides on-demand stablecoin liquidity so payment firms can settle cross-border without prefunding.
content.description: MANSA is liquidity infrastructure for cross-border payments. Instead of payment companies prefunding accounts in every country, it provides stablecoin capital at the moment of settlement, and handles collections, payouts, FX and treasury through a single API across 40+ corridors. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists MANSA.
content.meta: MANSA supplies on-demand stablecoin liquidity for cross-border payments across 40+ corridors, listed on Plasma.
